name: the editioned sheet as a physical object
function: It is one of a numbered run pulled from the same matrix, bought by somebody who went looking, carried home in a tube or a folder, and then either hung somewhere domestic or left in the folder for years. It is held in two hands before it is ever seen on a wall, and the holding is the first reading. It outlives the occasion that produced it by decades and is looked at by people who have no idea what the occasion was.
consequences: The first encounter is at arm's length, held, with the edges visible and the sheet's own surface part of what is being read. Nothing at this distance is missed, so anything approximate is seen to be approximate.

The second encounter is on a domestic wall at three or four metres, seen every day for years by somebody who stops noticing it. What survives that is not what wins the first look; a piece exhausted in the first month becomes furniture.
It is chosen and paid for. The viewer arrived willing, which removes the problem of getting attention and replaces it with the harder one of deserving attention that was already given.

It exists in a run of identical objects, each one a pull rather than an original, and the number on it says so. Being one of forty is a fact about the object that the viewer can see and will think about.

It ages in the hand and in the light: the sheet yellows, the margins foxing where fingers held it, and whichever ink is weakest goes first over twenty years of a lit room. The maker is composing for a thing that will still be looked at when it no longer looks the way it does now.

Reproduction is a matrix and a run, so what can be laid down is what the process will repeat forty times identically. A mark that cannot be pulled twice is not available, and the constraint is on the process, not the hand.
It has a real top and bottom and a margin that is part of the object. The sheet is bigger than the image and the untouched border is seen every time it is held.
It can be put away. Unlike anything on a wall in a public room, it has an off position, and a piece that is difficult to live with will be exercised into the folder rather than argued with.
doesNotDecide: Composition, palette, imagery, type, tone, scale relationships, which of the two encounters carries the weight, how much of the sheet is used, whether the margin is acknowledged, and what the piece is about. None of that follows from the edition.
